verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only contains vague marketing multipliers ('3X training, 15X inference vs previous generation') and hardware specs like memory (1,440 GB) and NVLink bandwidth (14.4 TB/s), but no actual TFLOPS/TOPS figures broken out by precision (FP4/FP8/FP16/INT8) or with sparsity stated — exactly the bare marketing number the story warns against. No datasheet-style tensor throughput table appears anywhere in the pack.
